title: Word Search II
summary: Return every dictionary word that can be traced on the board.

contractDetails.constraints: The rectangular board is 1–12 rows by 1–12 columns. It contains lowercase English letters. There are 1–30,000 distinct lowercase dictionary words, each of length 1–10.
contractDetails.output-checking: Require the complete set of independently verified board words. Reject duplicates and accept any order.

statement: Return every dictionary word that can be traced on the board. Successive cells share an edge, and a cell may appear at most once in a single path. Return each discovered word once in any order, even when several paths spell it. Leave the board unchanged after the call.

examples.explanation: The path around the square works, but a and c are diagonal.
A single cell cannot spell xx.
Multiple paths do not duplicate the result, and four cells are unavailable.

constraints: The rectangular board is 1–12 rows by 1–12 columns. It contains lowercase English letters. There are 1–30,000 distinct lowercase dictionary words, each of length 1–10.
hints: Conceptual: A partial path only matters if it is a dictionary prefix.
Directional: Build a Trie and carry its current node while exploring neighbors.
Implementation: Stop on missing edges. Track visited cells per path, and record each terminal word at most once without blocking longer words below it.
complexityAnalysis: O(S + mn·4ᴸ) worst-case time as a loose upper bound, with S total dictionary characters and longest length L. Auxiliary space is O(S + mn + L), excluding the result.
